description:
Location: Remote, on US working hours · Reports to: Chief Growth Officer

Background

Nash is the platform that powers modern logistics for brands like Walmart, Urban Outfitters, and 7-Eleven, alongside platforms like Shopify and Toast. Over the last year we've built a brand we genuinely love: a visual identity with real thought and meaning behind it, a motion system rooted in physics, a voice people notice, a website, a presence at the biggest trade shows in commerce.

We're already an AI-obsessed team. Now we want to see what happens when someone with real creative taste and flair pairs with the velocity we've built.

The Role

We believe brand is one of the most important things a company builds, and the person in this seat has real creative authority. You will shape how Nash looks, moves, sounds, and feels everywhere it shows up. Your taste sets the bar.

We are hiring an AI Brand Design Lead to take that brand and push it into territory that wasn't possible before AI. Not redesign it. Not maintain it. Push it: more expressive motion, tighter systems, higher craft, broader application, faster velocity, and new creative territory that only opens up when you treat AI as a core design tool.

Your superpower is taste. Your medium is AI. Your job is to make the two compound: taste sharp enough that AI finally gives you the velocity to match your ambition.

Just as importantly, you think about brand as a platform. You'd rather build a system that lets any marketer on this team, armed with Claude and the right prompts, produce something fantastic and on-brand than review every output yourself. You raise the ceiling for your own work. You raise the floor for everyone else's.

If you see AI as a threat to good design, this isn't the role for you. But if you believe that one person with real taste and the right tools can build a brand system that rivals teams ten times the size, and that the real unlock is making everyone on the team capable of shipping work with your standards baked in, we want to talk.

You'll report directly to our Chief Growth Officer (who spent his career building and leading marketing, growth, and product organizations at companies like Twilio, Plaid, and Salesforce). You'll work with our CEO, CTO, and a small, senior, fast-moving team across product, engineering, and growth.

What You'll Do

  • Extend and refine the Nash visual identity across motion, web, print, environmental, campaign, and product surfaces

  • Build the brand platform: prompt libraries, LLM-readable brand documentation, component systems, and template kits that let the whole team produce on-brand work with AI

  • Own the marketing site (fully Claude-coded): evolve it, ship new pages, raise the bar for craft and interaction

  • Create the work that wasn't possible before: generative illustrations, interactive explainers, AI-driven animations, brand content that would have taken a full studio and now takes you and a prompt

  • Produce the visual layer of the growth engine: decks, one-pagers, customer materials

  • Own booth and experiential design for trade shows (NRF, Manifest, Shoptalk) where Nash shows up with installations, not just a banner

  • Set the standard for craft and fix the system when something falls short, not just the artifact

Requirements

  • 6+ years in brand or visual design with a portfolio showing real range: identity, web, motion, campaign, systems

  • Has extended or evolved a brand at a high-growth technology company

  • AI-obsessed. Daily use of Claude, Midjourney, Runway, Cursor, or equivalent. Can show us the workflow, not just the outputs. If your portfolio is full of beautiful work but none of it involved AI, this is not the role

  • Systems thinker who can build a design kit, a prompt library, and a brand doc an LLM can reason against

  • Comfortable in Figma, After Effects, and Illustrator; bonus if you can ship a page with Claude Code

  • Treats taste as the skill that matters most, and AI as the tool that makes taste scale

How to Apply

We don't want your resume. We want to see your taste and how you apply it through tools.

Go to nash.ai. Look at our brand: read how we built it and explore the brand system. Then show us one example of how you would take something we already have and make it better. A tighter page. A motion concept. A campaign direction. An illustration style. A prompt template that generates on-brand output. Whatever catches your eye. Show us how you used AI to make it: the workflow, prompts, or system behind it, not just the output.

Send it however you want: a Figma file, a Replit prototype, a Loom, a PDF, a Claude artifact. No format requirements. Just the design idea.

Keep it small: an hour or two is plenty, and rough is fine. We're looking for your thinking and taste, not a finished deliverable. It stays yours.

A work sample is required to apply. Share it as a link or a file upload on the application form. Applications without one won't be reviewed.

More about Nash

Nash is the platform that powers modern logistics.

Commerce has inverted. For decades, customers came to where products and services were. Now products and services come to them, on their terms, in real time. That shift has turned every company into a logistics company, even though almost none of them were built to be one. Couriers, fleets, gig workers, parcel carriers, in-store labor, and increasingly autonomous systems all have to be coordinated in real time, against tighter windows and rising expectations, with hard-fought customer trust on the line.

Nash unifies decisioning, execution, and capacity into a single programmable platform. Real-time, AI-native intelligence determines what should happen, operational control executes it, and the platform dynamically orchestrates capacity from any source: a company's own fleets, partners, or the Nash delivery network. Whether a job involves a courier, a gig driver, an internal fleet, a store employee, a technician, or an autonomous vehicle, Nash selects the right resource and manages execution through completion.

We power delivery and logistics for some of the most recognizable brands in commerce, including Walmart, Urban Outfitters, 7-Eleven, and Woolworths, alongside platforms like Shopify and Toast. Over the next decade, logistics will become as foundational to commerce as payments, cloud, and connectivity. Nash is the platform that powers it.

Nash was founded in 2021 by Mahmoud Ghulman (2x Founder, MIT) and Aziz Alghunaim (2x Founder, 2x YC, Ex-Palantir, MIT) and is backed by Y Combinator, a16z, and other top investors. We are headquartered in San Francisco.

What You’ll Love About Us

✅ Early-stage, well-funded startup – directly impact the company and grow your career!
✅ Quarterly broader team on-sites to bond with teammates
✅ Competitive compensation and opportunity for equity
✅ Flexible paid time off
✅ Health, dental, and vision insurance for US employees
